hypothesis: An explicitly missingness-aware shallow model of price and derivatives features can improve net out-of-sample performance by producing calibrated return distributions and abstaining when edge does not exceed costs or evidence is unavailable.

implementationInterpretation.target: separate 1 3 and 6 bar future net returns; horizons are never pooled
implementationInterpretation.features: missingness_aware_calibrated_shallow_feature_panel_v1: twelve required causal price features followed by the five optional binance_derivatives_model_features_v2 fields and five optional coinbase_cross_exchange_model_features_v2 fields; every optional value has a separate observed/fresh mask and causal timestamp witnesses
implementationInterpretation.priceFeatureConvention: simple close-to-close returns; 6- and 24-bar population mean and standard deviation of one-bar returns; total-return spread; one-bar return minus 6-bar mean; 6/24 volatility ratio with zero only when the observed 24-bar volatility is at most 1e-12; and 6-bar minus 24-bar mean return
implementationInterpretation.sourceRequirements: complete OHLCV is required; derivatives and exact-bar same-symbol Coinbase context are optional whole panels whose individual unavailable values retain false masks; all present panels must match the exact symbol and grid and must have been decided no later than the primary decision
implementationInterpretation.imputation: the feature panel performs no imputation; each fold learns means and scales on its training prefix only, imputes an unavailable optional value to that training mean, then appends the unchanged availability masks; inference without a compatible fitted preprocessor abstains
implementationInterpretation.outcomeBlindClarification: Frozen on 2026-09-09 before registered collection: exact feature order, return/window formulas, source-scope checks, training-only imputation rule, and numeric repository-default model parameters. No market outcome, development result, or holdout was read; the total experiment budget and promotion gates are unchanged.
models: ridge conditional mean with residual empirical quantiles
current depth-one GBDT with split-conformal interval
current decision tree with split-conformal interval
implementationInterpretation.decision: take normalized 0.25 gross directional exposure only when the entire calibrated interval clears the frozen all-in cost floor; otherwise abstain
implementationInterpretation.failure: a required feature unavailable/stale, malformed shape, non-finite value/output, calibration failure, incompatible artifact, or timeout yields abstention

deviationsFromPapers: Uses shallow deterministic CPU models rather than broad equity neural networks.
Targets crypto-perpetual net return and explicitly evaluates abstention.
Adaptive calibration is not used unless separately implemented under a faithful versioned algorithm identifier.

universe.instruments: Binance USD-M perpetual futures with same-symbol spot explanatory ablation
universe.universeRule: time-series models are per instrument; pooled reports do not substitute for per-symbol evidence; any cross-sectional diagnostic uses trailing point-in-time liquidity and retains delisted members
universe.longShortRule: report probability calibration and economics separately for positive and negative positions

decisionTimestamp: close of the final completed feature bar after every source-specific publication and processing lag
assumedExecutionTimestamp: next bar open; plus one additional bar in delay stress
featureAvailabilityRules: event time and availability time are separate
first-seen-only sources begin at first observation
training-only imputation uses an explicit indicator and never manufactures an observed zero
required missing or stale families force abstention
normalization selection and calibration fit only on training/calibration prefixes
cross-symbol values require exact time and universe alignment

dataset.reason: Uses genuinely new data after the active prospective campaign; current April-September 2026 cache is insufficient and overlaps controlled evidence.

validation.design: nested expanding walk-forward development with train-only preprocessing and separate calibration suffix; one untouched chronological final holdout
validation.crossSymbolRule: per-symbol model and leave-one-symbol-out pooled robustness are separate hypotheses
validation.crossExchangeRobustness: repeat price-only feature metrics on causally aligned Coinbase spot observations where exact mapping exists
validation.finalHoldoutPolicy: one irreversible read after committed freeze; no adaptive successor reuses it

hyperparameterSearch.adaptiveSuccessors: prohibited without new registration and lifetime-count increase

transactionCostModel.baseline: frozen causal maker/taker fees, observed spread, slippage, funding, quantity/notional precision, latency and missed-fill rule shared with champion
transactionCostModel.extremeScenario: 25 basis points per unit turnover, adverse funding, 50 percent missed entries, and one-bar delay
transactionCostModel.impact: adverse square-root sensitivity reported separately; zero impact cannot authorize promotion

forecastMetrics: stability by horizon symbol and regime
statisticalTests: paired circular or stationary block-bootstrap confidence intervals
failureConditions: any future or revised value is backdated
